# 4 Maccabees Chapter 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Sinaiticus) | **Section:** The Martyrs' Divine Contest and Victory

---

**1** Truly the contest they were engaged in was a divine one, and the virtue tested was the virtue of endurance.

**2** The prizes for which they competed were imperishable, prizes of immortality and everlasting glory.

**3** Eleazar led the way as first; the mother of the seven was second in command; the brothers took the third place.

**4** The tyrant was their adversary and the world was their arena.

**5** These holy and devoted athletes were crowned by God as victors.

**6** Who among all who have heard of the courage of these brothers has not been moved? Who has not been brought to tears?

**7** The victory of these holy people, their endurance and their faithful deaths, has filled all the world with admiration and glory for Israel.

**8** Through the one mother and the seven brothers, tyranny was defeated and piety was proved unbreakable.

**9** For they overcame the tyrant by their patient endurance, and through them their nation was purified.

**10** Now it is fitting that I call blessed this holy woman and mother of the seven sons.

**11** Pure and holy woman, mother of seven sons!

**12** You kept your sons faithful to the ancient way; you set them on the path of virtue; and so you sent them on to God.

**13** O woman of eternal memory! Who is adequate to speak of you as you deserve?

**14** You endured a contest greater than any other; you gave up not merely your own life but seven lives, the lives of your beloved sons.

**15** You labored nine months for each one and raised them through years of toil, and then you gave them all back to God.

**16** You held devotion to God above your love for your children, and reason above your love of life.

**17** Therefore God will receive you as worthy of himself and will repay you with all the honor that is your due.

**18** Through your holy reason you governed all your passions and proved beyond all question that reason is sovereign.

**19** O mother who alone surpassed all women in the contest for the crown of piety!

**20** You are the mother of the nation, the champion of the law, the defender of faith.

**21** You are worthy of a divine and eternal song of praise from all people.

**22** For you were tried in the furnace of suffering and came out as pure gold.

**23** Let this mother take her place at the right hand of God together with Abraham and all the patriarchs of the faith.
